pages.text: In co-op the team gets $(l)one life, plus one per player$().$(br)Example: $(l)$(2)3 lives for 2 players$(), shared by the team.$(br)They show as $(l)hearts$() on your screen, bottom right.
When you fall you don't die outright: you go $(l)down$(), and a team-mate can come and $(l)revive$() you. Being revived still costs a life.
If $(l)everyone$() is down at once, you all respawn, but your $(l)$(c)gear drops$() where you fell. When the hearts run out, the run is over.
You can change the number of lives in $(l)Mods > Lucky Tweaks$(), but the pack is $(l)meant$() to be played this way.
